newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: UTENOS BEVERAGES TO JOIN BOURSE'S CURRENT LIST.
newsitem.headline: UTENOS BEVERAGES TO JOIN BOURSE'S CURRENT LIST.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that its board decided to list Utenos Beverages' securities on its current list from August 25.
The bourse said in a statement that 228,489 ordinary shares with a face value of 100 litas will be listed and the total face of the whole issue will be 22.849 million litas.
The statement added that both block trading and market transactions in the shares will be allowed from August 25.
Utena Beverages is one of the biggest breweries in the country and its shareholders decided in July to found a joint stock company with Baltic Beverages Holding AB (BBH).

BBH, which is owned on a 50-50 basis by Hartwall and the Swedish-Norwegian company Pripps Ringnes, and the Estonian company Hansa Investment, said last month that they will acquire a holding in Utena.
BBH also said that it and Hansa Investment will invest $12.5 million in the new company and will hold 50 percent of its shares.
Utena will hold the remaining 50 percent and will trasfer its current properties, brand names and complete stock of equipment to the new company.
